subject: Site Engineer, Civil Utilities, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Site Engineer, Civil Utilities role in Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. The ad describes an engineer building capability alongside experienced teams on water, sewer and utilities packages, which is the step I'm after.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works, where I did inspections, quality checks, procurement and materials tracking, and site, material and progress reports. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, covering road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design to Australian Standards, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

I have no water or sewer experience yet and I haven't used InEight, Aconex or Procore, so those would be new. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for site work, and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Glad to talk any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Site Engineer, Civil Utilities
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Site Engineer, Civil Utilities role in Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. The ad describes an engineer supporting delivery on major water, sewer and utilities packages while building technical capability alongside experienced project teams, and that is the step I'm looking for after a year on site and an Australian design diploma.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, passed on work priorities, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked the work against them, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving. Those are the day-to-day parts of your role: site coordination, quality and safety monitoring, procurement tracking and site records.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. The coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered hydraulics, construction methods and project delivery.

Where I fall short of the ad: I have no water, sewer or utilities project experience, my site work was overseas, and I have not used InEight, Aconex or Procore. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for site work, and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the project and what the site team needs.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to Adelaide: the letter and email say "open to discussing relocation to Adelaide". If the answer is no, do not apply.
Open https://www.seek.com.au/job/94930149 and follow Apply to the McMahon Services application page (see the careers URL on this record).

Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter); answer the portal questions honestly (no utilities experience, Subclass 485 visa to December 2027, real availability, willingness to obtain project clearances).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website".
notes: Large national contractor; early-career site engineer wording on a major SA water and sewer project. The "What you'll bring" list (utilities experience, InEight/Aconex/Procore) carries no essential marker, so those are disclosed as gaps rather than treated as a hold. Interstate: Adelaide relocation is Marc's call.
